english.title: Aid / assist trespass on the railway
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to section 16 of the Railway Regulation Act 1840.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes:
(i) The offence of trespass is not complete until there is a refusal to quit at the request of any officer or agent of the company. A clear request must be made to the person to leave, followed by either a specific refusal or a failure to depart within a reasonable time. Discretion should be used as a simple ejection may be all that is needed.
(ii) This offence can occur anywhere on railway property. There is no need to prove that notices are displayed in such a case.
(iii) It is for the justices to determine whether the trespass is wilful; see Jones v Taylor (1858) 1 EandE 20.
(iv) The maximum fine is fixed at level three in relation to railways covered by the following statutes- Channel Tunnel Act 1987 section 43; Midland Metro Act 1989 section 50; Leeds Super tram Act 1993 section 63.
